title: A 900-MHz 2.5-mA CMOS Frequency Synthesizer with an Automatic SC Tuning Loop
function_summary: voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO): It incorporates an automatic switched-capacitor (SC) discrete-tuning loop to extend the overall frequency tuning range to 20%, while the VCO gain ( VCO) resulting from the CMOS varactor continuous-tuning is kept low at only 20 MHz/V in order to improve the reference spurs and noise performance.
